== Summary ==
Kolla in leken - [[Johnny Ohlsson]] of Sweden played an awesome Star Trek CCG Tournament. Heja Sverige! (Thanks to Cristoffer Wiker and Jerker Andersson) Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
